notes: Official BWW Nutrition Guide (valid 08-18-2026 to 11-17-2026), linked from buffalowildwings.com/nutrition. Wing counts are plain (no sauce); add a sauce/dry rub item from Sauces, Dry Rubs & Extras (2 fl oz / 1 tsp portions). The guide's per-wing-count sauce portions and range rows (e.g. "Add Signature Sauce 60-330") were omitted. Rows with two values (A / B) were split into two items; "option 1/2" follow the order named in the item (e.g. "with Bacon or Sausage"). Beer is not covered by the guide. Atwater outliers (>20%, left as published): House-Made Guacamole (1 serving): 100 cal vs 122 Atwater; Black Bean Burger Patty (1 serving): 200 cal vs 250 Atwater; B-Dubs Bloody Mary - at select locations (1 serving): 140 cal vs 58 Atwater; Blue Long Island Iced Tea (1 serving): 220 cal vs 104 Atwater; Blue Watermelon Cooler (1 serving): 190 cal vs 116 Atwater; Boozy Dunkin’ Cold Brew (1 serving): 300 cal vs 200 Atwater; Bourbon Old Fashioned - at select locations (1 serving): 200 cal vs 64 Atwater; Buffalo Trace Old Fashioned - at select locations (1 serving): 220 cal vs 72 Atwater; Buffalo Zoo - limited time (1 serving): 240 cal vs 124 Atwater; Caesar - at select locations (ND & SD only) (1 serving): 180 cal vs 80 Atwater; Classic Espresso Martini (1 serving): 210 cal vs 96 Atwater; House Margarita (1 serving): 230 cal vs 108 Atwater; Old Fashioned (1 serving): 220 cal vs 64 Atwater; Mezcal Margarita (1 serving): 230 cal vs 96 Atwater; Modelo Michelada (1 serving): 140 cal vs 68 Atwater; ...
